text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a profound sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history, specifically a deadly disease that affected her during her youth, which fuels her dedication to finding a cure. Despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and skepticism from her professional peers, she remains resilient. Her character development highlights her ability to maintain hope and determination in the face of overwhelming odds, showcasing her unwavering commitment to her goal.
